sources.title: Strixhaven Available Now
sources.author: Wizards of the Coast
sources.relevant_summary: Official product page describing Strixhaven's five colleges and Lorehold as the College of Archaeomancy, with students characterized as researchers, adventurers, and history-focused scholars.
limitations: Brief marketing overview rather than a detailed lore guide.
sources.notes: Reviewed as official source. Citation: citeturn631979view2

sources.title: Planeswalker's Guide to Strixhaven
sources.author: Doug Beyer and Ari Zirulnik
sources.relevant_summary: Official world guide covering Strixhaven University, the five colleges, Lorehold's red-white identity, campus locations, roles, spirit statues, and the order-vs-chaos dichotomy.
limitations: Represents the original 2021 setting guide; later 2026 sources add updated story context.
sources.notes: Reviewed as official source. Citations: citeturn427453view0 citeturn701593view2

sources.title: The First Lesson: Introduction to Strixhaven
sources.author: Wizards of the Coast
sources.relevant_summary: Official introductory article providing compact college identities and Lorehold's motto, 'Leave no stone unturned.'
limitations: Introductory marketing/overview article; less detailed than the Planeswalker's Guide.
sources.notes: Reviewed as official source. Citation: citeturn631979view7

sources.title: Strixhaven: School of Mages Mechanics
sources.author: Matt Tabak
sources.relevant_summary: Official mechanics article explaining learn, Lesson, magecraft, ward, and modal double-faced deans for Strixhaven.
limitations: Rules/mechanics source; does not provide deep character lore.
sources.notes: Reviewed as official source. Citations: citeturn701593view3 citeturn701593view4

sources.title: Strixhaven: School of Mages and Commander (2021 Edition) Release Notes
sources.author: Jess Dunks and Matt Tabak
sources.relevant_summary: Official release notes containing rules explanations and card-specific text for Strixhaven, including Lorehold Apprentice, Lorehold Command, Plargg/Augusta, Quintorius, and Velomachus Lorehold.

sources.notes: Reviewed as official source. Citations: citeturn501983view0 citeturn501983view1 citeturn501983view2 citeturn501983view3

sources.title: The Mentor
sources.author: Reinhardt Suarez
sources.relevant_summary: Official Lorehold-focused story centered on Quintorius Kand, Effigy Row, spirit mentors, The Rousing, and Lorehold archaeomancy.
limitations: Narrative source centered on Quintorius; should not be overgeneralized to all Lorehold students without support from broader sources.
sources.notes: Reviewed as official source. Citation: citeturn890741view2

sources.title: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
sources.author: Evelyn Teng
sources.relevant_summary: Official story showing Quintorius during the New Phyrexian invasion of Arcavios, including Lorehold-style spirit/statue magic used to seek guidance.

sources.notes: Reviewed as official source. Citation: citeturn890741view4

sources.title: Planeswalker's Guide to Secrets of Strixhaven
sources.author: Wizards of the Coast
sources.relevant_summary: Updated 2026 official guide expanding Lorehold's identity, order/chaos tension, field studies, areas of study, the Blood Age, and present-day Arcavios geography.
limitations: Current as of review date; later story releases may change details.
sources.notes: Reviewed as current official source. Citations: citeturn890741view0 citeturn701593view1

sources.title: The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven
sources.author: Wizards of the Coast
sources.relevant_summary: Official character/legend guide for Secrets of Strixhaven, including Kirol, Mica, Aziza, Velomachus/Lorehold the Historian, Quintorius, Excava, and Augusta Order Returned.
limitations: Character-focused source; not every entry is a full lore history.
sources.notes: Reviewed as current official source. Citations: citeturn890741view1 citeturn701593view0

sources.title: Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense
sources.author: Seanan McGuire
sources.relevant_summary: Official story showing Quintorius returning to Arcavios, Dean Augusta Tullus as a spirit/stone-like ongoing dean figure, and fieldwork at the Fields of Strife.
limitations: Narrative source; some events are specific to Quintorius and should not be generalized to all Lorehold.
sources.notes: Reviewed as current official source. Citation: citeturn348781view3

sources.title: Secrets of Strixhaven Commander Decklists
sources.author: Jubilee Finnegan
sources.relevant_summary: Official 2026 Commander decklist article listing the Lorehold Spirit deck and associated Lorehold Spirit tokens.
limitations: Decklist/source for product composition; not a primary narrative source.

sources.title: polarkac/MTG-Stories repository
sources.author: polarkac
sources.relevant_summary: Repository archive of publicly available MTG stories. Used as archive/discovery support and cross-reference for requested Lorehold terms including Velomachus Lorehold, Quintorius, Hofri, Plargg, spirit, relic, archaeology, history, ruins, scroll, artifact, red white, magecraft, and learn.
limitations: Repository archive, not primary canon when official Wizards pages remain available.
GitHub code search required sign-in in the browser view; repository files were fetched directly by known paths from the Typst index.
sources.notes: Reviewed repository landing/release information only. Citation: citeturn759470search1

sources.title: The Mentor (MTG-Stories repository archive)
sources.author: Reinhardt Suarez
sources.url_or_repository_path: stories/042 - Strixhaven: School of Mages/007_The Mentor.typ
sources.relevant_summary: Repository archive copy of the official Strixhaven side story The Mentor. Used to enrich Lorehold data around Quintorius Kand, Asterion, Effigy Row spirit mentors, The Rousing, Pillardrop excavation, Hofri Ghostforge, Lorehold repositories, and the rules-versus-justice tension in Lorehold practice.
limitations: Repository archive, not primary canon when official Wizards story pages are available.
Narrative evidence from one story should not be generalized to every Lorehold student without corroboration.
sources.notes: Fetched from the repository after GitHub code search did not return accessible content; inspected as requested search support.

sources.title: Field Studies in a Future Tense (MTG-Stories repository archive)

sources.url_or_repository_path: stories/063 - Secrets of Strixhaven/009_Field Studies in a Future Tense.typ
sources.relevant_summary: Repository archive copy of the Secrets of Strixhaven Lorehold side story. Used to enrich Lorehold data around Quintorius returning to Arcavios, Augusta Tullus as spirit dean, Fields of Strife research, Mica, artifact preservation, and the ethical contrast between archaeology and theft.
limitations: Repository archive, not primary canon when official Wizards story pages are available.
Story-specific actions by Quintorius, Mica, or Augusta should not be treated as universal Lorehold behavior.
